name: Virag Instagram Content Design Library
principles: A creative is a designed information system, not a cinematic product picture.
Default canvas is 1080×1350 vertical 4:5 with a clear phone-size hierarchy.
Use the exact product plus short readable copy, two to four information modules and at least three visible 2D graphic layers.
The selected preset controls the campaign technique; the output-format selector controls the final deliverable.
Every variation uses a different idea, grid, copy composition and graphic language.
Preserve product identity and facts exactly; every requested output is separate.

commands.label: Fresh Instagram Post
commands.desc: Original blank-canvas 4:5 feed creative · finished social layout.
commands.instruction: Generate one finished, full-bleed 4:5 Instagram feed post using only the current-turn product and references. Create a fresh social-native idea with a clear two-second hierarchy, balanced product scale, premium graphic language and natural mobile composition. Do not make a print poster, giant-title layout, flyer, plain product photo or background swap. SOCIAL CONTENT EXECUTION: The selected preset controls only the visual technique. Under Instagram Creative or Instagram Infographic format, compose a finished 4:5 feed design with the exact product, short accurate readable copy, two to four visible information modules, at least three deliberate 2D graphic layers and a clear phone-size hierarchy. The product scene must occupy only part of the designed layout. Never return a cinematic product shot, plain packshot, pedestal render, static title poster, text-free image or background-only variation.
